source.title: Orange Fruit Image Dataset for Classification

selection: Seed 20261030; shuffle sorted archive members, first 80 fresh and 80 rotten; manually exclude doubtful labels/localizations. No predictions used as ground-truth classes.
limitations: Supplemental oranges differ from target kumquats.
224px images do not gain true detail when upscaled.
Many images are near-duplicates or augmented versions of a few physical fruits. All supplemental images stay in one training-only group.
Provisional visual review has not been independently adjudicated.
No supplemental image or augmentation may be used for evaluation.
